definition: a kind of sickle used to sever thorns of a plant.
example_en: The gardener cut the thorny plants with the sickle (muḷugatti).

definition: (law) born of parents not married to each other; not in the legal position of those in wed locked or legitimised; illegitimate.
example: ಅನೌರಸ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ತಂದೆಯ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕು ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The illegitimate child did not get a right to the father's property.

definition: (rhet.) the style that is pleasant, lucid, vivid and very attractive considered as the merits in poetics.
example_en: The style of pleasant charm stands out clearly in this poem.

definition: courage; braveness.
example: ಶತ್ರುವಿನ ಮುಂದೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಎದೆಭಾವ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He needed courage to stand before the enemy.

definition: a man, not having required qualification or not being chartered, carrying on the profession of or acting as a lawyer or legal adviser.
example_en: In the village an unqualified lawyer was arguing in the court.

definition: to be forsaken; to be abandoned or deserted.
example_en: The old house was abandoned and fell into ruin.

definition: to face bravely; to confront boldly.
example_en: The hero confronted the lion bravely.

definition: a piece of cloth for wearing round the loins; loin-cloth.
example_en: He wrapped a loin-cloth around his waist.

definition: genesis - a) the way in which something comes to be; beginning; origin; b) the first chapter of a book (usu. a classical one).
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಆದಿಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯ ಕಥೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: The genesis chapter of that book contains the story of creation.

definition: a parasol with red cloth; a red umbrella.
example_en: The servants held a red umbrella over the queen.

definition: a waking or being awake.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಕಿರಣ ಅವನ ಅವಬೋಧಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The morning sunlight caused him to wake up.

definition: a man who is bitten (as by a snake).
example_en: They took the snake-bitten man to the doctor.

definition: that which is - a) smooth, tender; b) bright, shining; c) beautiful, attractive; d) agreeable, amiable; e) sharp, keen; e) loveable; f) musical, melodious.
example_en: Her voice sounded melodious.

definition: a particular type of elaborate literary composition, which uses both prose and verses.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕವಿಗಳು ಚಂಪು ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾವ್ಯ ರಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Ancient poets composed poetry in the campu style.

definition: a man who washes clothes, as his profession; a washerman.
example_en: The washerman was washing clothes near the river.

definition: a string of beads used in religious worshipping; rosary.
example: ಸಾಧು ಅಕ್ಷವಲಯವನ್ನು ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sage held the rosary in his hand and meditated.

definition: the nozzle of a water-vessel.
example_en: The nozzle of the water-vessel broke.

definition: the quality that delights the eyes; beauty; charm.
example_en: Charm was evident on her face.

definition: the stiff erectile bristle of a porcupine.
example_en: The porcupine's stiff bristle pricked my hand.

definition: to fill (something) with.
example_en: He filled the sack with rice.

definition: a share of the produce from a land to be given to the owner by the cultivator.
example_en: The practice of the landowner's share still prevails in the village.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: The female dancer danced gracefully at the fair.

definition: that which causes, brings comfort, solace.
example_en: Those words appeared comforting to me.

definition: the shore, bank (of a river) on the other side.
example: ನದಿಯ ಅಕ್ಕರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a small village on the far bank of the river.

definition: the disc of the moon.
example_en: The disc of the moon appeared brightly in the sky.

definition: to feel the chillness.
example_en: After getting drenched in the rain, he felt a chill.

definition: the look or the aspect of an object as seen from one of its sides; a side view.
example_en: The side view of the hill looks beautiful in the picture.

definition: to utter a short saying.
example_en: He uttered a short saying.

definition: to cause to jump up or over.
example_en: He made the boat cross over the river.

definition: a man who is crippled, has an incapacitated limb or limbs; a disabled man.
example_en: That disabled man walks with the help of a stick.

definition: a danger to life.
example_en: In this accident, there was danger to his life.

definition: a loose, oblong piece of cloth used as a headgear.
example_en: The grandmother wrapped the loose oblong cloth around her head.

definition: to behave arrogantly, desdainfully or contemptuously.
example_en: After gaining wealth, he began to behave arrogantly.

definition: the sound resonated from the big semi-spherical part of a vīṇe or tambūri.
example_en: The resonant sound from the tambura's bowl felt pleasant in the temple.

definition: a mountain in the Himalayas in Tibet, considered to be the abode of Śiva, and the seat of Kubēra, the regent of wealth.
example_en: Kailasa is worshipped as the abode of Shiva.

definition: because of which; on account of which.
example_en: I do not know because of what he did not come.

definition: a man belonging to a caste the main profession of the members of which is trading and business.
example_en: A komaṭi (trader caste man) opened a shop in the market.

definition: the muscle at the flank.
example_en: His flank muscle ached from running.

definition: the killing of a human being or beings; homicide.
example: ಆ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದ ನರಹತಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A large-scale killing of human beings took place in that war.

definition: to make a gesture with the hand.
example: ಅವನು ದೂರದಿಂದ ಕೆಯ್ಮಾಡಿ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನನ್ನು ಕರೆದನು.
example_en: He made a gesture with his hand and called his friend from afar.

definition: to be full of juicy; to be succulent.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳು ರಸಮೆಟ್ಟಿ ತಿನ್ನಲು ರುಚಿಯಾಗಿವೆ.
example_en: After the rain the fruits have become full of juice and taste delicious to eat.

definition: a male offspring of a woman of higher caste or class from a man of lower caste or class.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರತಿಲೋಮಜ ಮಗ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That son born of a higher-caste mother and lower-caste father held a distinct place in society.

definition: (the sun) to move towards western horizon (as in the evening).
example_en: In the evening, the sun began to move towards the western horizon.

definition: (obs.) (pl.) those who are neither too far nor too near.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಉವರ್ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಅಪರೂಪವಾಗಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The word uvar is rarely used in that text.

definition: a piece of chalk, white or coloured, used for drawing, writing on a blackboard, etc.
example_en: The teacher wrote on the board with chalk.

definition: submarine fire.
example: ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಊರ್ವಾನಳ ಸಮುದ್ರದ ತಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In the puranas, it is said that the submarine fire burns at the bottom of the sea.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example_en: The fort gate broke due to the use of the projectile.

definition: to act imitating another; to play a role (as in a play).
example_en: The actor imitated the role of the king well.

definition: causing inauspiciousness; marring or impairing the well-being or prosperity.
example_en: He did not listen to the words that mar prosperity.

definition: a dancing to the rhythm of drum-beatings.
example_en: He danced to the rhythm of the drum-beats.

definition: any evil supposed to have been caused by a ḍākini.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಡಾಕಿನಿದೋಷವೇ ಕಾರಣ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ನಂಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They believed that the evil caused by a dakini was the very cause of the child's illness.

definition: the father of one's grandfather or grand mother.
example_en: Her great-grandfather used to tell old stories.

definition: a man who takes photographs (esp. as an occupation or hobby); photographer.
example_en: That photographer took photos of the wedding.

definition: to crush or grind with the teeth; to chew; to masticate.
example_en: The child chewed the meat that was hard to bite.

definition: a tidal wave rushing with great violence toward the shore; a bore.
example_en: The tidal bore of the river submerged the houses on the bank.

definition: an officer appointed by a king to head a department in the palace or a village, etc.; a headman.
example_en: The village headman used to look after all the affairs.

definition: an official who collects, disburses and keeps a records of receipts and payments of cash, in an office organisation, etc.; a cashier.
example: ಕಚೇರಿಯ ನಗದು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನದ ಹಣ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The office's cashier recorded the daily cash accounts.

definition: to go on with; to carry on; to continue.
example: ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸು ಎಂದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They decided to continue their research.

definition: to keep (something) at the back of.
example: ಅವಳು ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಮಗುವಿಗಾಗಿ ಪಿಂದಿರಿಸಿ ಇಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: She kept the sweet aside at the back, saved for the child.

definition: a man who habitually lies.
example_en: A habitual liar never tells the truth.

definition: an excellent bed or spread to sit or lie on.
example_en: An excellent spread was laid out for the guest to sit on.

definition: a brief record of something written down to assist the memory or for future reference or to inform someone else; a note.
example: ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನು ನೋಟು ಬರೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He wrote a note about the important matters.

definition: the plant Scilla indica of Liliaceae family.
example_en: Wild scilla plants grew at the edge of the forest.

definition: storm accompanied by rain.
example: ಸಮುದ್ರ ತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಂಝಾನಿಳ ಎದ್ದು ದೋಣಿಗಳು ಮುಳುಗಿದವು.
example_en: A storm with rain rose on the seashore and boats sank.

definition: to join (with another or others) as a companion, partner, friend, etc.; to associate (oneself) with.
example_en: He associated himself with good friends.

definition: to immigrate, en masse , from the normal place of living, to settle in another, permanently or for a relatively longer period (esp. necessitated by famine, disaster, etc. or by threat or coercion).
example_en: Out of fear of war, the families had to migrate en masse.

definition: one who wishes well to another or to a cause; a well-wisher.
example_en: He is a well-wisher of mine.

definition: to exhale breath from the nose and mouth in a sudden, involuntary, explosive action, as a result of an irritation of the nasal mucous membrane; to sneeze.
example_en: The dust made him sneeze.

definition: a kind of dish made with minced vegetables.
example_en: Mother made a minced vegetable dish from fresh vegetables.

definition: struck; knocked; dashed against; lashed.
example_en: The horse, lashed by the whip, ran fast.

definition: a literate woman.
example_en: The number of literate women increased in the village school.

definition: a kind of jute or hemp; .
example_en: The farmers grew jute on the side of the field.

definition: the state of waiting for, wishing for (something) impatiently.
example: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವಳ ಯಲ್ಲಕ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Her impatient waiting for the result increased day by day.

definition: a man having qualities that are regarded as characteristic of women and girls, as weakness, cowardliness, etc.; a coward.
example_en: He is a coward and faces no challenge.

definition: to move or agitate air with or as with a fan; to fan.
example_en: The servant fanned the king.

definition: the act of blowing, blooming, developing (as a flower).
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂವಿನ ಕಾಸ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಇಂಪಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The blooming of the flower in the morning sun was pleasing to the eye.

definition: because of; on account of; as a result of.
example_en: Because of the rain, a holiday was declared for the school.

definition: a cord; a rope.
example_en: He drew water from the well using a rope.

definition: a request for help, sympathy, etc.; an appeal.
example: ಬಡವನ ಮನವೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They heard the poor man's appeal and helped him.

definition: (rhet.) in literary works, an accepted manner of describing as natural a thing which is non-existent.
example: ಕವಿ ಈ ಪದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸದಾಖ್ಯಾತಿಯನ್ನು ಚಮತ್ಕಾರವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The poet has skillfully used the rhetorical figure of asadakhyati in this verse.

definition: a movement of a ship or ships.
example_en: There was much movement of ships at that port.

definition: water falling over a cliff or from a height; a waterfall.
example_en: Tourists had come to see the tall waterfall.

definition: wide; large; broad.
example_en: That ground looks very wide and large.

definition: (milk) to have an oily, yellowish cream on its top.
example_en: After the boiled milk cooled, it formed a layer of cream.

definition: a bamboo, split length-wise, with slings on both sides for carrying burden, across the shoulder.
example_en: The labourer carried the bundles on the split bamboo yoke.

definition: fried or roasted.
example_en: They used roasted almonds for the dish.

definition: a hall where dance performances are or are meant to be, presented; a dancing hall.
example_en: A dance performance was held in the dancing hall in the evening.

definition: that cannot be seen; that cannot be perceived by senses directly.
example_en: Devotees believe that God is invisible to the senses.

definition: an elephant in rut.
example_en: The elephant in rut raised its trunk and trumpeted.

definition: a mean, base, petty-minded man.
example: ಆ ಬಣಗ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಬಳಿ ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That mean, petty-minded man used to lie to everyone.

definition: to become dull, discoloured.
example_en: The cloth's colour became dull and discoloured from the sun.

definition: drawn or passed over by the tongue; licked; brought into a certain condition by passing the tongue over.
example_en: The dog left the vessel that it had licked.

definition: (dial.) a kind of grass that grows as a weed.
example_en: The weed grass grew and spread green across the field.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear; to be distressed by the emotion of fear.
example_en: Seeing the snake, she became afraid.

definition: a projection from a fortification; a bastion.
example_en: Guards stood on the bastion of the fort.

definition: the plant Phyllanthus lawii of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The plant Phyllanthus lawii grows abundantly on the slope of the hill.

definition: any stringed musical instrument.
example_en: The veena is a stringed instrument.

definition: the act of wearing (a dress, attire, etc.).
example: ಹೊಸ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ತೊಡಹ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: Wearing the new dress brought her joy.

definition: the fact of being from an ignoble family.
example_en: His lowly birth brought him disgrace.

definition: Viṣṇu, Lakṣmi's husband.
example_en: The devotees praised Lakshmi's husband with devotion.

definition: the condition of being confined (in or as in a jail).
example_en: His confinement continued for three days.

definition: one sentence.
example_en: He summarized the entire book in one sentence.

definition: amounting to one hundred thousand in number.
example_en: The population of that town has exceeded one hundred thousand.

definition: a petty folk-dog.
example_en: The petty folk-dog was wandering near the field.

definition: a protruding belly; pot-belly.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ದೋಣು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That person's pot-belly caught everyone's attention.

definition: uncombed hair.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing his uncombed hair.

definition: an act or spell of struggling; a continued effort to resist force or free oneself from constraint; a strong effort under difficulties; struggle.
example: ಬಡತನದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಆತ ಬಹಳ ಕಟಿಪಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He struggled hard against poverty.

definition: very high or tall.
example_en: That very tall tree can be seen from far away.

definition: the quality of being quick, swift, prompt, etc.; quickness; swiftness.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the runner's swiftness.

definition: the tanned skin of a rabit.
example_en: He covered himself with the tanned rabbit skin during that winter.

definition: the pavilion in front of a temple.
example_en: A music program was held in the temple pavilion.

definition: a washing of the floor with this or with cow-dung.
example_en: They washed the courtyard with cow-dung water.

definition: a screen made by weaving thin strips of bamboo, used as a partition wall, screen, etc.
example_en: They had put up a bamboo screen in front of the house.

definition: a story that made up or imagined; an untrue account of an incident, event.
example_en: It turned out that all his words were made-up stories.

definition: the strength of the fore-arm.
example_en: The wrestler's fore-arm strength startled his opponent.

definition: the plant Hedysarum gangeticum.
example_en: Physicians use the Hedysarum gangeticum plant in medicine.

definition: a somewhat S-shaped nozel of a water container, for pouring water.
example_en: Water flowed slowly from the pot's curved nozzle.

definition: a single hand.
example_en: She wrung the cloth with a single hand.

definition: to make less hard to bear; lighten or relieve (pain, suffering, etc.); to alleviate; to mollify; to soothe; to pacify.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ರೋಗಿಯ ನೋವನ್ನು ಸಂತಿಡಲು ಔಷಧಿ ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine to soothe the patient's pain.

definition: a boy not of full or mature age.
example: ಆ ಅಪ್ರಾಪ್ತವಯಸ್ಕ ಹುಡುಗನಿಗೆ ಚಾಲನಾ ಪರವಾನಗಿ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That boy who was not of mature age did not get a driving license.

definition: one who delivers postal letters; a postman.
example_en: The postman delivers letters to every house daily.

definition: a story of a person's life written or dictated by himself or herself; autobiography.
example_en: That author wrote his autobiography.

definition: a baby kept across one's stretched arms.
example_en: The mother lifted the baby lying across her arms and put it to sleep.

definition: that which is flat (and usu. relatively thin).
example_en: This biscuit is flat and thin, and breaks easily.

definition: without blinking one's eyes; in a baffled state.
example_en: He looked at everyone with an unblinking, baffled gaze.

definition: a bundle of betel leaves.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಹೊತ್ತಳವನ್ನು ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper carried a bundle of betel leaves on his head and went to the market.

definition: to measure the depth of water in a well, stream, pond, etc.
example_en: One must measure the depth of the water in the well.

definition: a belt, band or sash for the waist.
example_en: He tied the waist-belt tightly.

definition: energetic action; liveliness; alertness.
example_en: Because of the young men's alertness, the work finished quickly.

definition: a harmonious living together (of husband and wife).
example_en: That couple's harmonious living together was a model for the whole village.

definition: a strong wish or craving; a desire.
example_en: Her desire was to receive a good education.

definition: the father of one's grandfather or grand mother.
example_en: His great-grandfather was an elder of the village.

definition: a slightly raised platform (for resting, transacting business, etc.); an estrade.
example: ಊರ ಜನರು ಕಟ್ಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The villagers sat on the raised platform and talked.

definition: the stiff rod to which a lash is attached.
example_en: The horse rider held the whip's rod tightly.

definition: the act of pressing; compression.
example_en: The compression in the air pump was high.

definition: a kind of vīṇe, a stringed musical instrument.
example_en: The teacher taught the āṇevaṇi to the disciple.

definition: a long horn (as of an ox).
example_en: The ox's long horn was very lengthy.

definition: to mark with small dots.
example_en: Before the worship, they marked the floor with small dots of rice.

definition: to kick mutually.
example_en: The two boys laughed while kicking each other in the game.

definition: an internally binding relation.
example_en: There is an internally binding relation between the two of them.

definition: along with; together with.
example_en: They came along with the children.

definition: to cause to separate by cutting or severing.
example_en: He cut the rope with a knife.

definition: to have a doubt; to be not sure of.
example_en: He was having doubts about that matter.

definition: a day of absence from one's duty.
example_en: Because of illness he got two days of absence from duty.

definition: to turn white; to become white.
example_en: After the rain, the sky turned white.

definition: a strong or offensive smell; a stench.
example_en: A strong stench was coming from the heap of garbage.

definition: a jacket, overcoat made of rags.
example: ಆ ಬಡ ಮುದುಕ ಹರಿದ ಕಂಥೆಗುಪ್ಪಸ ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That poor old man wore a jacket made of rags.

definition: that which has a sweet sound; the Indian cuckoo (a long-tailed songbird of the family Cuculidae, which has a characteristic two or three-note call and deposits its eggs in the nests of crows which rear the young as their own).
example_en: The Indian cuckoo was calling in the mango tree.

definition: a member of a class of gods; a celestial singer.
example_en: The gandharas sing sweetly in heaven.

definition: to twist strands of fibre (to make a rope).
example_en: He twisted the fibre strands to make a rope.

definition: this much quantity, number, capacity; etc.
example_en: This much rice is enough for me.

definition: a practice so long established that it has the force of law; a custom.
example: ಈ ಊರಿನ ಪಳಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಹಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They celebrate the festival according to this village's custom.

definition: a small timepiece designed to be worn on the wrist; a wrist-watch.
example_en: She bought a new wrist-watch.

definition: an administrative division of a state; a district.

definition: a man having qualities that are regarded as characteristic of women and girls, as weakness, cowardliness, etc.; a coward.
example: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆದರುವ ಅವನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಪೇಕುಳಿ ಎಂದರು.
example_en: Everyone called him a coward, for he feared even small matters.

definition: intense sexual desire.
example_en: There was intense sexual desire in his mind.

definition: any one of a series of moments at which the same or nearly the same thing recurs; a repeated occasion; a time.
example_en: This time he got victory.

definition: a kind of eatable made using curds.
example_en: Grandmother made curd balls for the festival.

definition: (pl.) the two flanks; both the flanks of a person.
example_en: Both his flanks were swollen from the injury.

definition: he who has a large number of vehicles.
example: ಆ ಪತ್ರಾಢ್ಯನ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಅನೇಕ ವಾಹನಗಳಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: In front of that owner of many vehicles' house there were many vehicles.

definition: the tree Michelia figo ( = M. fuscata) of Magnoliaceae family.
example: ಬೇಡಹುಟ್ಟ ಚಂಪಕ ಮರದ ಪರಿಮಳ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The fragrance of the Michelia figo tree spread everywhere.

definition: to have or suffer from extreme scarcity of.
example_en: During the drought, people suffered from extreme scarcity of food.

definition: the act or practice of tricking; use of tricks; deception; trickery.
example_en: His trickery was finally exposed.

definition: to immigrate, en masse , from the normal place of living, to settle in another, permanently or for a relatively longer period (esp. necessitated by famine, disaster, etc. or by threat or coercion).
example_en: Because of the famine, the people migrated en masse to the neighbouring country.

definition: a man connected with another or others by blood, marriage, etc.; a relative.
example: ಅವನು ನಮ್ಮ ತೆತ್ತಿಗ, ಮದುವೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He is our relative, connected to us through marriage.

definition: a common man.
example_en: A common man was working in the field.

definition: a vertical fold of cloth (as of a sīre, dhōti, etc.).
example_en: The pleats of her sari were very neat.

definition: the excess of one quantity or number over another; difference.
example_en: The age difference between the two is ten years.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: The hunter hurled a spear at the wild boar.
